The '''smithing table''' upgrades equipment with [[alloy]]s; see [[Smithing]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
It is crafted from 4 planks and 2 [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]], so steel comes first.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/smithing_table.json}}</ref> Obtaining one grants ''Master Metallurge''.
